title: A paid exact RK representation gives ordinary determinant marginals
statement: For simply connected open rectangular square graphs in the ORTHOGONAL perfect-matching Hilbert basis, a_e>0 rational, w_e=a_e^2, A_M=product_e_in_M a_e and Z=sum_M A_M^2. Rank-one plaquette PSD terms (v_p|h>-u_p|v>)(adjoint), u/v horizontal/vertical amplitude products, annihilate Psi=sum A_M|M>/sqrt Z. Uniqueness only within connected flip graph; periodic winding sectors retained. Diagonal occupancy w_e partial_e log Z. Actual bipartite K has horizontal w and vertical i*w, Z=|det K|; exact Gaussian integer determinants/cofactors compute one/pair occupancies. Existing RK/Kasteleyn gives SAME information: O(n^3) arithmetic plus integer-height/bit costs; exponential matching enumeration is only finite falsification. Producer fixtures2x4 Z5/5matchings/5flip pairs;4x4unit Z36/36matchings/70pairs;4x4 a_e=1+(edge index mod3),Z486972,36matchings,70pairs,corner occupancy91/167 agrees enumeration/cofactor. Four-spin valence-bond overlaps +1/2,-1/2,+1/2 and relation |12,34>-|13,24>+|14,23>=0 falsify naive orthogonal matching replacement. No automatic generic four-port/Heisenberg/spin-wavefunction mapping or controlled projection error is earned.

requires: Even periodic L square spin-1/2 J1-J2 at alpha=1/2; D_L=sum (-1)^x S_xy dot S_x+1,y; e(h)=lim lambda_min(H-hD)/L^2; m_D=-e-prime(0+). Observable norm density <=3/4. Positive m_D selects only columnar pi,0 bond order. Zero excludes only this component, not vertical/plaquette/topological/gapless alternatives.

Each positive control has its own exact sector/model assumptions; source-faithful quantum dimer basis is orthogonal and has specified positive rational edge amplitudes. Finite-field lower bound needs independently proved uniform field/volume curvature modulus.
